name: 33540 · Zephyrhills, FL
findings: ZIP 33540 (Zephyrhills) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33540 (Zephyrhills) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
